chapters.title: Chapter 1962 You will never be able to stop me.
paragraphs: [Don't play games with me, boy.]
"The game already started the moment you targeted my wives, Zylarith Chaosveil.
There is no going back now."
Nux answered in a cold tone as he appeared in front of the second Sovereign.
[Do not force me to do things I would rather not. I have been holding back all this while because I want you by my side, to fight together with me, but if you insist on opposing me,
I will have no choice but to discard you, even if you are my Soul Son.]
Zylarith threatened, and at his words, Nux just laughed.
"Oh no, I am so scared. My father, who cannot even find me, is threatening me."
[So this is why you were so confident, huh?]
Suddenly, Zylarith realized something.
[You have an artifact that allows you to hide your existence, huh? I will admit, that is indeed quite useful. The fact that you were able to get your hands on it is quite impressive.]
The Progenitor of the Supreme World of Chaos praised. Soon, however, his tone changed.
[This is the reason I say you are naïve, child.
You think everyone in this Universe plays fair. You think that just because you have the ability to hide yourself, the enemy will be helpless.
But this is where you are wrong.
Who do you think I will target if I cannot find you?]
Zylarith questioned.
And before Nux could reply,
[It will be your wives.]
Zylarith answered his own question.
"Even if you somehow hide your wives, I will target Yrniel. I will slaughter every single being in that world, one by one, and I will make their deaths as slow as possible.
I will make them pay for your actions.
Because of your actions, the people you grew up with will suffer. The families of your wives, the people you are close with, the people you once called allies,
I will crush each and every single one of them until you or your wives cannot take it anymore and decide to appear in front of me of your own accord."
Zylarith explained, gloating at the extent of cruelty he was prepared to show.
But Nux...
"So you are that clueless, huh?"
He laughed.
Then, as if he realized something, he commented.
"You must have stopped bothering to keep an eye on Yrniel after Lord Azriel went to sleep."
Zylarith paused at those words, unable to understand what Nux was talking about. However, not wanting to appear weak, he continued with his threat.

"Don't think that Vampire will be able to save Yrniel either. The Supreme Worlds may be my enemies, but that doesn't mean I do not have a way to inform them about that Vampire's existence without revealing my own.
How do you think those bastards would react to the news of there being another Infinity who is stronger than them?
Both Yrniel and Azriel will be—"
"Haaahh..."
In the end, Nux just sighed, shaking his head in disappointment.
"I was expecting more, Father.
This isn't even a challenge."
Nux muttered as he threw away the body of a Primordial he had just devoured using the devouring mist after reading his memories.
Suddenly, as if thinking of something, he called out,
"Father, I am in Yrniel. Come find me.
If you do, we will negotiate some terms."
[...What terms?]
"Why don't you come here first? You aren't scared, are you?"
Nux smiled. Zylarith, however, remained silent, something that made Nux smile even more.
He waited for a few more seconds, and seeing that Zylarith still hadn't spoken, he continued.
"What happened? Why are you not here yet? Can't find Yrniel? Almost looks like it disappeared from the Universe, doesn't it?"
Zylarith remained silent.
What could he even say?
Only now did he realize the problem.
Yrniel...
It didn't exist anymore.
And if Nux had found a way to hide himself and his wives, which he seemed to have, considering Zylarith couldn't even locate the mercenaries he had hired, then this would mean...
Nux no longer had any weaknesses.
And that wasn't all.
"You should be very careful about who you threaten and how you do it, Father."
Nux started.
"You didn't think Lord Azriel would be the only one the Supreme Worlds would be delighted to know about, did you?
After all, you will be quite the target too.

How do you think those old bastards would react when they find out that their old friend is currently sticking with the Leader of a High-Level World, helping her fight a war against another High-Level World, spreading Chaos all over the Universe?
What do you think they will do when they find out about your existence?"
Zylarith didn't say anything.
Nux, however, could already assume the expression on his face.
He, however, had only just started.

"They will destroy the world and the army you helped that woman build. They will capture that woman and try to find out everything they can about you. With their means, it shouldn't take them a long time to find and get rid of you."
"Of course, I am not going to do that."
Nux quickly shook his head.
"After all, where's the fun when I don't even get to see you despair as you die?
It is indeed as you say, Father. I am quite naïve.
I want to put you to your death myself. I have learned quite a few ways to make death more... exciting.
Ways you might be familiar with."
Nux smiled lightly.
"Not to mention I really admire that story.
To pick up an enslaved princess, help her escape, grow stronger, and reach a point where she could stand against a High-Level World and avenge her family.
How very heroic~
I wonder what relationship you have with this one.
Well, I guess I will find out soon enough when I come for you."
Nux shrugged, and then suddenly, his playful persona disappeared as his golden eyes shone with absolute coldness.
"Yes, Zylarith Chaosveil, this is an open declaration.
I am coming for you and whatever you have built.
I will destroy it with my own hands, and no matter how desperately you try,
You will never be able to stop me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1963 The Princess who rose from the Chains
paragraphs: Yes, Zylarith Chaosveil, this is an open declaration.
I am coming for you and whatever you have built.
I will destroy it with my own hands, and no matter how desperately you try,
You will never be able to stop me."

Nux spoke, and before Zylarith could say anything else, he destroyed the artifact in his hand. Once again, he felt the space around him tremble. That father of his was trying to find where he was, but with his control over space, it was pretty much impossible.
Thud
With a cold expression on his face, Nux threw away another Primordial's body after reading his memories. The devouring mist devoured him out of existence as Nux continued.
Right now, he was in Khaemorr, a High-Level World his father was in.
Yes, all this while, as his father desperately tried to find him, he was right under his nose, threatening and openly declaring his intentions without any fear.
And it wasn't just him; his wives were walking around with him.
After all, the moment they sensed someone, Marlik moved and brought him to Nux.
"Did you find out anything interesting?"
Felberta, who was walking beside Nux, questioned with a curious look on her face.
"It is all the same."
Nux shook his head.
"That would make sense. The Primordials in this world are like a dime a dozen; they wouldn't know much, especially not the sensitive information the higher-ups would want to hide."
Aeliana muttered, and the rest of the women nodded.
Right now, they were doing what they called knowing the enemy. Now that all of them were part of Nux's Universe, the Will of Worlds could not sense them, and the women decided to abuse this.
They directly walked into the world they were up against and decided to find out everything they could about this place.
"What was that princess story you mentioned before?"
Suddenly, Allura glanced at Nux and questioned.
"I was quite intrigued by that."
She muttered, her purple eyes shining meaningfully, and Amaya, who saw the look on the succubus's face, narrowed her eyes when she understood what she was thinking.
"She is an enemy."
"We do not know that, do we?"
"We do."
Amaya nodded.
"You are too boring~"
Allura waved her hand. Once again, her eyes were back on Nux.
"She is the leader of this world, an Eternal."
"An Eternal, eh?"
Allura's grin widened.
"Sounds very... useful."
She muttered, making both Aeliana and Amaya narrow their eyes.
Eisheth, on the other hand, agreed wholeheartedly,
"Indeed, indeed."
Felberta chuckled at the two's antics.
"What is her story? Why did your father help her? He doesn't seem like the helping kind."
"I am not sure if he helped her."
Nux answered.
"You said it, though..."
"It was only an assumption; otherwise, her story doesn't add up."
"What is her story?"
The Eldraeth Progenitor questioned.
"All of you are just a bunch of mannerless rogues."
Allura snorted as she then glanced at Nux.
"Let's start with her name.
I am getting a good vibe from her."
"You get good vibes from everyone, even the mother-daughter foxes."
Amaya snorted.
"I am much surer this time."
"You were much surer last time t—"
"Oh, come on!
Just tell me her name."
Allura glanced at Nux, and he started.
"She is Sharnoth Nocthys, the Princess who rose from the Chains."
"The Princess who rose from the Chains, eh...?"
Allura repeated those words, her smile widening even more.
Nux nodded.
"It all dates back to millions of years of rivalry between two worlds named Nocthys and Aurendor, both being High-Level Worlds that belong to different factions.
Nocthys was part of the Faction of Darkness, the faction led by the Supreme World of Darkness, while Aurendor was part of the faction led by the Supreme World of Light."

Sharnoth was the Princess of Nocthys. One day, Sharnoth's father, their Progenitor, an Eternal, who was returning from a trip, was suddenly attacked by the enemies, and since he was outnumbered, he couldn't survive.
The instant he fell, Nocthys became nothing more than a delicious piece of meat for the wolves around it, and very quickly, the wolves pounced on it.
The first to attack was Aurendor.
Nocthys and Aurendor were always at war with each other, and since there was no winner for millions of years, it was clear that there wasn't a big difference between their strength.
But with Nocthys's Progenitor dead, the enemies had an extra Eternal.

It was impossible for Nocthys to win. In the end, the Nocthys Royal Family surrendered, the Princess, Sharnoth Nocthys, was enslaved and taken to Aurendor, and once a renowned High-Level World, Nocthys turned into nothing but a territory where all sorts of experiments were done using the world's energy.
"Tragic."
Aeliana muttered.
Honestly, she wasn't actually affected by the story.
The rest of the women were the same.
It was simply how the world and the universe worked. The instant Nocthys weakened, its destruction was set in stone.
The very fact that Sharnoth was alive was a surprise.
"What happened next?"
Evane questioned. Since she knew there would be a twist, she was looking forward to it. She wanted to know how Sharnoth did what she did.
She was somewhat rooting for her.
The rest of the women were curious as well, but...
"That's the issue. No one knows what happened next."
Nux answered.
The women frowned, and he continued,

"Sharnoth was enslaved, but a few days later, around a hundred thousand years ago, somehow, she managed to escape. No one knew how she did, and no matter how much effort was put in to capture her, none could find her."
"That is... strange."
Vyriana muttered, narrowing her eyes.
This didn't make sense.
After all, if Sharnoth was the Princess, the direct descendant of Nocthys's Progenitor, it meant her potential was only slightly weaker than her father's.
No matter how one looked at it, she was a threat.
A High-Level World would never make the mistake of letting her go. After all, no one wanted an extra enemy, especially one who had the potential to destroy them.
"Indeed.
Aurendor is a High-Level World. They have thousands of means of capturing someone. A powerless princess should never be able to run away.
Especially when her cultivation was ruined, she would have died within a few decades anyway."
"She managed to escape when she had no cultivation?"
"Not only that, when she returned, she was stronger than her father."
Nux answered, surprising the women.

She then swore to destroy Aurendor and started recruiting people for her cause. Her army rose much quicker than anyone could expect. She gathered allies, formed alliances, and now, she had grown to the point that she and her world, Khaemorr, have become Aurendor's greatest threat.
"What the..."
"So the reason you think your father helped her is because..."
"Because it wouldn't make sense otherwise."
"But what would Zylarith even do in this situation?"
Aeliana questioned.
"You underestimate him."
Nux shook his head.
"He was the one who created my System, remember?"
"Are you saying... he gave her the system?"
Melia questioned, somewhat taken aback.
"I do not know."
Nux shook his head.

"I doubt that is possible since the energy required to create the system is absurd, but that man was once a Progenitor of the Strongest Supreme World. If you think he has no other means to get what he wants,
You are wrong."
"But... why would he help her...?"

"How can I know what he is thinking? I am not even sure if he is actually helping her or not. The only reason I came up with this theory was because the mission those two Transcendents received was from Khaemorr.

What are we going to do now?"

"That would be too risky."
Aeliana shook her head.
"We need to get stronger."
Amaya muttered.
"That's the issue. I do not know what to do."
Nux clenched his fists.
"What...?"
"Laws related to Darkness, Light, and Balance are all in Supreme Worlds. We cannot target them, not right now.
The only link to the Law of Chaos is Zylarith, and he hides together with an Eternal.
The only Law left is..."
"The Law of Time..."
Aeliana muttered.
"The Seer..."
Amaya said a name.

Nux shook his head.
"If I do anything, I need to do it myself."
"What are you going to do...?"

Felberta questioned.

"There is... the Temple of Time."
Nux muttered.

Sharnoth was the Princess of Nocthys.
One day, Sharnoth's father, their Progenitor, an Eternal, who was returning from a trip, was suddenly attacked by the enemies, and since he was outnumbered, he couldn't survive.
The instant he fell, Nocthys became nothing more than a delicious piece of meat for the wolves around it, and very quickly, the wolves pounced on it.
The first to attack was Aurendor.

But with Nocthys's Progenitor dead, the enemies had an extra Eternal.
It was impossible for Nocthys to win.

It was simply how the world and the universe worked.

Nux muttered.

I don't know anything about it."
Nux shook his head.
"Huh?"
"There is just a name. It is supposed to be a myth, and since there was no concrete knowledge, not even the Umbrasol Progenitors looked into the matter."
Nux answered.
"That's strange. Didn't you say the Umbrasol Progenitors were extremely curious beings?"
"They were, but they were also very efficient and thorough. If they believed every single rumor and acted upon it, they wouldn't have gotten anywhere.
Not to mention, they were at War when they heard this name, so they didn't have the forces to spare on a baseless rumor."
The women turned silent at those words.
"And you didn't hear anything about this Temple after you devoured all other worlds?"
"Never heard the name a second time."
Nux shrugged.
We do not know anything?"
Vyriana muttered, and Nux nodded at her words.
"The Seer clearly has a Law related to Time. Why isn't she helping us?"
Melia couldn't help but question.
"She says that the number of times she can help me is limited."
Nux answered.
"Well, then this is high time for her to help, no?"
"And why is that?"
Nux questioned back, and suddenly, Melia turned silent.

"She ensured that all of you are finally connected to me. She dealt with the matter of Yrniel, making it so that I can even threaten a High-Level World without any fear whatsoever. She made it so that right here and right now, we can all decide to start living in my Universe and do nothing, and nothing will come to harm us.
She has done enough already, don't you think?"
"She wasn't the one who did it..."
Rune countered.
"If what she says about already knowing how the Universe would Lord Azriel is true, then she indeed did it all."
The women turned silent.
Nux, on the other hand, shrugged.
"It doesn't matter what she did and what she didn't.
We are safe now. Now we can take risks we couldn't before. If we ask for more help, we might as well lean on her and let her do everything.
After Time, it will be Chaos, then Light, Darkness, and Balance. Are we going to seek her help in everything?
Do not forget,
She is not one of us."
"Not yet."
Allura added.
The women turned towards her, and she blinked.
"What? I get good vibes from her."
This time, Amaya just shook her head and sighed, not wanting to continue the same conversation as before.
Rather, she turned towards Nux and said,
"What's the plan then?"
"I usually rely on you to come up with a plan, you know? I am the one who should ask this question."
Nux smiled wryly.
"I have something, but it will take a long time and... it is quite heartless."
"You want to start devouring every world?"
Amaya nodded, clearly ashamed of the idea.

Not because it was heartless—for her Nux, she didn't care how many she needed to kill—but she also knew that while Nux had no qualms killing, doing it for a 'chance' of finding something was not something he would do, especially when that chance is ridiculously low.

Not to mention, the plan itself was quite impractical. There were billions of worlds in the Universe. Nux couldn't just start devouring everything. The Universe would never sit idly if he did that and might even choose to self-destruct.
Amaya knew that, and so did Nux.
Nux smiled wryly. To think even his Amaya was helpless. How many times has this happened?
In the end, he closed his eyes and started.
"The Law of Time is becoming a bigger problem than what I gave it credit for, especially considering that I should already have parts of it in some way or another."
Nux glanced at Aeliana and said,
"The Law of Absolute Control allows me to Control Time."
Then, he glanced at Rune.
"The Law of Absolute Foresight gives me precognition. My instincts can now react to attacks that haven't happened, and my body can react to it faster than ever."
Then, he turned towards Amaya.

"I can devour Time itself, allowing me to Stop Time to a certain extent. I can create Time-Space Rifts, I can create Time Echoes, I can hide inside another Timeline, making it impossible for anyone to sense me. I can do all this, yet...
I am unable to comprehend Time or any Law related to Time for that matter.
It... doesn't make sense."
The women were silent.
"It is as if..."
"The Universe doesn't want you to comprehend the Law of Time."
Aeliana completed that sentence, and Nux, who was now looking at her, nodded at those words.
"It is similar to the Law of Absolute Space."
Felberta commented.
"No."
Nux, however, shook his head.
"Faelara was able to comprehend the Law of Absolute Space. The Universe didn't stop her. The Fox Progenitor was the same. She comprehended Absolute Space as well.
But Time... no one has comprehended the Law of Time."
"Or maybe we just do not know who has."
Nux turned silent.
He couldn't deny that possibility.
"Faelara, huh..."
Suddenly, Edda muttered.
She had entered her serious mode since Nux seemed like he needed her help.
"Didn't the Foxes have the Bloodline that allowed them to comprehend Time and Space much easier than others?"
She pointed out, and Nux narrowed his eyes at those words. Soon, however, he shook his head.

"I read their memories. There was no one amongst the Foxes who managed to comprehend the Law strong enough to actually call it the Law of Time, or even a part of it. Vulpiana's Law was stronger than all of them combined."
"Mhm, their Bloodline wasn't very strong."
Aeliana nodded at those words. Soon, however, the ring on her finger shone, and suddenly, a Box appeared in her hand.
"But if you do need it, I have the Bloodline."
She revealed.
"You do?"
"My subordinate extracted it when they went to the Foxes to charm them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1965 Why didn’t I think of this before?
paragraphs: "Mhm, their Bloodline wasn't very strong."
Aeliana nodded at those words. Soon, however, the ring on her finger shone, and suddenly, a Box appeared in her hand.
"But if you do need it, I have the Bloodline."
She revealed.
"You do?"
"My subordinate extracted it when they went to the Foxes to charm them."
Aeliana answered, and Edda smiled.
Nux, however, shook his head.
"Their blood isn't strong enough."
"It is something, no?"
"I already have more than something."
Everyone turned silent again.
"So... are we back to square one?"
"We are not."
Amaya shook her head.
The Devourer then turned towards the Vampire and said,
"A High-Level World was after the Foxes, wasn't it?"
"Yes. Orynthar."
Aeliana nodded.
"It is the same world that..."
Aeliana clenched her fists, not wanting to say anything anymore.
"Yes, this."
Amaya pointed out.
"Orynthar was at War with Yrniel too. Lord Azriel said that your Mothers incapacitated that world before they died."
Aeliana stared at the devourer. She didn't say anything, but her eyes reflected her... emotions. Amaya, however, completely ignored the Vampire and turned towards Nux instead.
"It doesn't make sense."
"What doesn't?"
"Lady Ithania and Luminia were Eternals. Orynthar was up against Two Eternals, so according to it, Yrniel should have been a higher-level world, and a strong one since they couldn't defeat it.

Yet they still sent a force after the Foxes' World. It is said that they did it because they wanted their Power for themselves, but did they really have resources to divert their attention? Extracting a Progenitor's bloodline was possible, but creating a Progenitor and starting an entirely new Race required a decent amount of Energy.
Energy they shouldn't have since they were at War against an enemy that wasn't weak. They... might have had ulterior motives when they attacked the Foxes."
"What could it be?"
Nux questioned.
"Who knows?"
Amaya shrugged.
"Orynthar doesn't exist anymore. My father destroyed it. Even if they had ulterior motives, it doesn't matter now. We wouldn't know anything."
Aeliana reminded everyone. Amaya turned silent at that.
"No."
Nux, however, shook his head.
His expression changed as an idea popped into his head.
"Orynthar isn't there, but its Subordinate Worlds should still be."
"And how are we going to find those worlds?"
"Do you know Orynthar's Coordinates?"
Nux questioned.
Aeliana shook her head.
"I do not.
But my Father should."
Nux nodded.
'Mother.'
He called out, using the connection he now had with the Progenitors.
'Nux?'
Faustina answered.
'Is everything alright? Do you need me?'
The mother questioned.
'Is Lord Azriel there?'
'He is. He is making us fight each other while he is cultivating.'
'Tell him that I wish to talk to him.'
'What happened?'
'There is something I need to ask.'
'Alright.'
Faustina nodded as suddenly, an Artifact in Nux's Storage Ring started vibrating.
[What is it?]
Azriel questioned directly the instant Nux picked his call.
[Unless it's Aeliana who wishes to speak with me,
Be quick. I am busy.]
Nux's mouth twitched at those words.
He, however, just shook his head, already used to the old man's antics, and said,
"Orynthar, where are its Coordinates?"
[Why?]
"Just answer. Didn't you say you are busy? For a busy man, you sure are asking a lo-"
Before Nux could even use this chance to get back at his Father-in-Law,
The old man answered as he cut the call.
"W-Wai-"
Nux tried to call out, but the old man was already gone.
With a deadpan look on his face, he turned towards his wives and said,
"He didn't tell me if these are Universal Coordinates or Yrniel's."
"He shouldn't know Universal Coordinates."
Aeliana muttered.
"Even if he does, I don't think he would use it."
"He could have clarified."
Nux snorted.
"Well..."
Aeliana didn't say anything.
She didn't wish to choose between her husband and her father.
Nux shook his head, dropping the matter, and then, his expression changed.
"Let's go."
With a wave of his hand, he teleported everyone to the Coordinates Azriel had given, and the moment he got there, he narrowed his eyes.
"A new World."
Thyra muttered.
"Well, it has been a long time. It would be strange if there wasn't a new world here already."
Felberta added.
"So what next?"
Edda questioned as she glanced at Nux.
"What else?"
Nux shrugged as he glanced at thousands of worlds here.
"Our search area has narrowed down. We can start from here and see if any of these worlds know anything about Orynthar."
"Are we going to devour all these worlds?"
Evane questioned.
"No, only the Middle-Level Worlds."
Nux answered.
"Why only the Middle-Level Worlds?"
Melia questioned.
"Other than High-Level Worlds we cannot attack, they should know the most and..."
Nux's smile then widened, and he said,
"I also happen to have quite some slots in my Universe.
I can accept a few more Transcendents."
'Should we not deal with these two first?'
Suddenly, Shadow spoke up, staring at the two Transcendents that were thrown to the corner of the Universe.
The poor fellas had already tried everything in their power to try and escape, but no matter what they did, no matter who they tried to call, nothing happened.
They were already in despair.
"Right."
Nux had honestly forgotten about them.
He nodded as he then returned to the Universe with his wives. Using memory manipulation, he quickly turned the two into loyal subordinates.
With that, he now had three Transcendent-Stage Subordinates.
"It should be enough to take on a Middle-Level World, no?"
Eisheth questioned.
"A Weak Middle-Level World, maybe.
The Stronger ones usually have around eight to nine Transcendents. It will be difficult to take them on."
"You can always start with the weakest and climb your way up."
Aisha chuckled, and Nux grinned at those words.
"That's the plan."
But then, suddenly,
"Actually, I have a better plan."
Eisheth spoke up.
"Hm?"
Nux tilted his head in confusion, and Eisheth and Skyla stepped forward. Eisheth had her usual playful smile on her face, while Skyla, on the other hand, seemed oddly proud and excited.
"Let us help."
Eisheth spoke up. Skyla nodded at her words, and the moment Nux understood what they were trying to do,
A demonic grin appeared on his face as well.
'Why didn't I think of this before?'
He tilted his head and then thought,
'The two of them together should be unstoppable.'

sentences.text: "Mhm, their Bloodline wasn't very strong."
Aeliana nodded at those words.
Soon, however, the ring on her finger shone, and suddenly, a Box appeared in her hand.
"But if you do need it, I have the Bloodline."
She revealed.
"You do?"
"My subordinate extracted it when they went to the Foxes to charm them."
Aeliana answered, and Edda smiled.
Nux, however, shook his head.
"Their blood isn't strong enough."
"It is something, no?"
"I already have more than something."
Everyone turned silent again.
"So... are we back to square one?"
"We are not."
Amaya shook her head.
The Devourer then turned towards the Vampire and said,
"A High-Level World was after the Foxes, wasn't it?"
"Yes.
Orynthar."
Aeliana nodded.
"It is the same world that..."
Aeliana clenched her fists, not wanting to say anything anymore.
"Yes, this."
Amaya pointed out.
"Orynthar was at War with Yrniel too.
Lord Azriel said that your Mothers incapacitated that world before they died."
Aeliana stared at the devourer.
She didn't say anything, but her eyes reflected her... emotions.
Amaya, however, completely ignored the Vampire and turned towards Nux instead.
"It doesn't make sense."
"What doesn't?"
"Lady Ithania and Luminia were Eternals.
Orynthar was up against Two Eternals, so according to it, Yrniel should have been a higher-level world, and a strong one since they couldn't defeat it.
Yet they still sent a force after the Foxes' World.
It is said that they did it because they wanted their Power for themselves, but did they really have resources to divert their attention?
Extracting a Progenitor's bloodline was possible, but creating a Progenitor and starting an entirely new Race required a decent amount of Energy.
Energy they shouldn't have since they were at War against an enemy that wasn't weak.
They... might have had ulterior motives when they attacked the Foxes."
"What could it be?"
Nux questioned.
"Who knows?"
Amaya shrugged.
"Orynthar doesn't exist anymore.
My father destroyed it.
Even if they had ulterior motives, it doesn't matter now.
We wouldn't know anything."
Aeliana reminded everyone.
Amaya turned silent at that.
"No."
Nux, however, shook his head.
His expression changed as an idea popped into his head.
"Orynthar isn't there, but its Subordinate Worlds should still be."
"And how are we going to find those worlds?"
"Do you know Orynthar's Coordinates?"
Nux questioned.
Aeliana shook her head.
"I do not.
But my Father should."
Nux nodded.
'Mother.'
He called out, using the connection he now had with the Progenitors.
'Nux?'
Faustina answered.
'Is everything alright?
Do you need me?'
The mother questioned.
'Is Lord Azriel there?'
'He is.
He is making us fight each other while he is cultivating.'
'Tell him that I wish to talk to him.'
'What happened?'
'There is something I need to ask.'
'Alright.'
Faustina nodded as suddenly, an Artifact in Nux's Storage Ring started vibrating.
[What is it?]
Azriel questioned directly the instant Nux picked his call.
[Unless it's Aeliana who wishes to speak with me,
Be quick.
I am busy.]
Nux's mouth twitched at those words.
He, however, just shook his head, already used to the old man's antics, and said,
"Orynthar, where are its Coordinates?"
[Why?]
"Just answer.
Didn't you say you are busy?
For a busy man, you sure are asking a lo-"
Before Nux could even use this chance to get back at his Father-in-Law,
The old man answered as he cut the call.
"W-Wai-"
Nux tried to call out, but the old man was already gone.
With a deadpan look on his face, he turned towards his wives and said,
"He didn't tell me if these are Universal Coordinates or Yrniel's."
"He shouldn't know Universal Coordinates."
Aeliana muttered.
"Even if he does, I don't think he would use it."
"He could have clarified."
Nux snorted.
"Well..."
Aeliana didn't say anything.
She didn't wish to choose between her husband and her father.
Nux shook his head, dropping the matter, and then, his expression changed.
"Let's go."
With a wave of his hand, he teleported everyone to the Coordinates Azriel had given, and the moment he got there, he narrowed his eyes.
"A new World."
Thyra muttered.
"Well, it has been a long time.
It would be strange if there wasn't a new world here already."
Felberta added.
"So what next?"
Edda questioned as she glanced at Nux.
"What else?"
Nux shrugged as he glanced at thousands of worlds here.
"Our search area has narrowed down.
We can start from here and see if any of these worlds know anything about Orynthar."
"Are we going to devour all these worlds?"
Evane questioned.
"No, only the Middle-Level Worlds."
Nux answered.
"Why only the Middle-Level Worlds?"
Melia questioned.
"Other than High-Level Worlds we cannot attack, they should know the most and..."
Nux's smile then widened, and he said,
"I also happen to have quite some slots in my Universe.
I can accept a few more Transcendents."
'Should we not deal with these two first?'
Suddenly, Shadow spoke up, staring at the two Transcendents that were thrown to the corner of the Universe.
The poor fellas had already tried everything in their power to try and escape, but no matter what they did, no matter who they tried to call, nothing happened.
They were already in despair.
"Right."
Nux had honestly forgotten about them.
He nodded as he then returned to the Universe with his wives.
Using memory manipulation, he quickly turned the two into loyal subordinates.
With that, he now had three Transcendent-Stage Subordinates.
"It should be enough to take on a Middle-Level World, no?"
Eisheth questioned.
"A Weak Middle-Level World, maybe.
The Stronger ones usually have around eight to nine Transcendents.
It will be difficult to take them on."
"You can always start with the weakest and climb your way up."
Aisha chuckled, and Nux grinned at those words.
"That's the plan."
But then, suddenly,
"Actually, I have a better plan."
Eisheth spoke up.
"Hm?"
Nux tilted his head in confusion, and Eisheth and Skyla stepped forward.
Eisheth had her usual playful smile on her face, while Skyla, on the other hand, seemed oddly proud and excited.
"Let us help."
Eisheth spoke up.
Skyla nodded at her words, and the moment Nux understood what they were trying to do,
A demonic grin appeared on his face as well.
'Why didn't I think of this before?'
He tilted his head and then thought,
'The two of them together should be unstoppable.'

chapters.title: Chapter 1966 The Law of Absolute Enchantment.
paragraphs: A 3-meter-tall being, with a muscular, powerful body covered in dark red skin and faintly glowing veins, and deep crimson eyes, ended the meeting held within his meeting hall and was returning to his room.
He was Varos Bloodrend.
The Progenitor of a Middle-Level World named Morblood.

As the strongest being in Morblood, he lived in a castle that had Morblood's strongest beings protecting it. The castle had underground tunnels that connected it to the entire world, allowing Varos to move from one place to another without being seen.

These tunnels weren't just for him; his spy network used the same tunnels, strengthening his information network to the point where his enemies were crushed before they could even form a workable plan.
Catching Varos's spies was next to impossible. If one was caught, they would simply use the secret tunnels and disappear, replaced by another.

Because of this, Varos knew almost everything there was to know about Morblood: the different factions of Morblood, the hidden factions, their goals, and their leaders. He even knew more about his own subordinates than their family members did.
It could be said that almost nothing in Morblood could surpass him.

His reign was absolute. Stronger than any of the previous Progenitors, so much so that Morblood hadn't been at war for the last 10,000 years simply because enemies could never reach a level where they would be a threat to Varos.

They were killed before that, and because Varos's information network was so strong, there were no deserters or runaways amongst the enemies. All of them were killed without exception, rooting them out from their very core.

Even now, in the meeting, Varos had just given the order to decimate another group of rebels that had started to grow in influence. Knowing they would be rooted out just like the others, Varos was about to return to his room and rest.
But then,
"Lord Varos."

The moment he walked in, his eyes fell on the most beautiful woman he had ever seen. The woman had long purple hair and purple eyes. She was sitting on his chair with one leg over the other, and when her seductive eyes fell on him, a light smile appeared on her face. She greeted him with a voice so... beautiful that he had a hard time believing it was real.
"Who are you?"
Varos questioned as he stood still.

It was a surprising sight for anyone who knew this man. After all, Varos was a man who wanted to have everything under his control. For a woman he didn't know to be in his room—in a normal situation—he would have already deployed his Domain and gotten rid of her.
But...
For some reason, this time, he stood still, not doing anything.
He wanted to chat instead.
But then,
"This place is so pretty~
This dark red material used for the walls, floor, and ceiling, and these glowing crimson veins, make it look like a living entity."
Another adorable voice, filled with innocence, was heard.

Varos turned around, surprised to see another woman standing near the window, appreciating everything around her like a curious child who was impressed by what she was seeing. This one had auburn hair and big blue eyes.
The woman, sensing that Varos was looking at her, turned toward him and smiled brightly.
"Hello~
My name is Skyla, and she is my sister Eisheth."

Skyla spoke, pointing at Eisheth, who was still sitting on the chair, as if judging Varos. It was a look that would have gotten a Sovereign like her killed without any questions asked, but again, Varos didn't feel offended.
More than offended, he was... curious.
Yes, he was curious. That was all it was.

And how could he not be? These women came out of nowhere. One of them was a Human, and the other was of a race he didn't know about. What he did know for sure, however, was that these women weren't from Morblood.
They came from another world.
They were Outworlders.
And yet... Morblood's Will didn't alert him of their arrival.
This had never happened before, and Varos wanted to get to the bottom of it.
Now, could this have been done after capturing these women? Yes, it could, but Varos simply didn't feel the need to do it. He was strong enough to deal with these women even if they did anything.
Yes, he had no reason to be wary. He was still in control.
"What are you two doing here?"
So he questioned.
"We came here to meet you."
Skyla answered with an excited smile on her face. At those words, Varos momentarily gulped as he stole glances at Eisheth, who hadn't moved ever since she arrived and was only staring at him.
"Why me?"
"Obviously because you are the strongest in the world. No matter where we go, we only hear about you and the things you did, so much that we had to meet you.
Especially Sister Eisheth; she was very interested."
Skyla smiled, once again pointing at her sister.
Varos turned toward Eisheth and looked into the woman's eyes.
"What is she interested in?"
He questioned.
At those words, Eisheth finally moved. It wasn't something grand; she only adjusted her posture and placed her other leg on top. Varos waited patiently, and Eisheth began,
"I do not want any needless bloodshed. Surrender."
"What...?"
Varos narrowed his eyes dangerously, but even when the woman disrespected him like this, his mind remained serene.
After all, the two of them were still not dangerous.
And...
Since they are Outworlders, "surrender" in their language could mean something else too.
Yes, it was indeed one possibility. Rather than coming to conclusions and acting recklessly, he should wait.
And that is what Varos did. He waited for Eisheth to continue.
The woman smiled at that—a smile that made Varos flinch a little. He wanted to see it... more often.
Snap

The woman then snapped, and suddenly, her shadow trembled. Three beings materialized around her, and just like the woman, Morblood's Will didn't tell him about their presence either—something that made Varos frown even more.
Now he was even more curious.
Just what was happening?
Who were these people?
Why wasn't Morblood's Will warning him about them? Was it some sort of sign?
Varos began to wonder.

Again, if anyone who knew Varos saw this scene, they wouldn't be able to wrap their heads around it. In some way, sparing the two women still made sense. They were Sovereigns; they couldn't possibly do anything to Lord Varos. But...
Now the room had three Transcendents. It was no longer "safe."
And yes, while Varos was never strong enough to take on three Transcendents at the same time, if he activated his Domain first, considering how strong his Law was, there might be a chance at victory.
At the very least, it was much better than being at their mercy.
Someone like Varos should know that better than anyone, and yet...
He still stood still, not doing anything but... chatting.
Even now, when three Transcendents stood right in front of him, he was looking at Eisheth, waiting for her to explain things.
It made absolutely no sense.
Well...
At least not to beings who were judging the situation when they weren't in Varos's room.
After all, the entire room was filled with the Aura of Serenity that Skyla had been releasing constantly.
Skyla's Law of Serene Bond, which had now turned into the Law of Absolute Serenity, was at work here.
And no, Skyla's Law wasn't just strengthened.
After Nux severed her connection with the Main Universe, the adorable maid had turned into a different level of monster altogether.
Before, Skyla's Law had a big weakness. Whenever she activated her Law, Primordial-Level Beings were able to sense her Law Flow, knowing that she activated some sort of power.

If it was activated during a conversation and these beings felt a strange sense of calmness the instant they saw the Law Flow, it was easy to understand what sort of Law Skyla had. And once they knew, resisting it was only a matter of will.
Now, however, that had changed.
Now, Skyla's Law Flow couldn't be seen. The Aura of Serenity, which had now gotten stronger because of Nux strengthening her Law, couldn't be sensed by enemies.
Their minds just felt... relaxed.
A state every being craved in one way or another, and their bodies accepted it naturally. Even if the being was a Transcendent far stronger than Skyla, her powers still worked on them.
What's worse?
Skyla wasn't alone.
After all, the only thing she did was calm Varos, making him much more patient and welcoming than he actually was.
The rest was done by Eisheth and her Law.
The Law of Absolute Enchantment.

A Law that allowed the former Succubus Queen to have supreme control over any being through desire, beauty, and charisma. A Law that ensured no being could resist her—physically, mentally, or spiritually.
No, it wasn't straight-up seduction.
With how possessive Nux was, he would have never allowed it. It was... something more.

Right now, what Varos was feeling wasn't just desire and lust for Eisheth's body. What he was craving was the woman's presence. He was craving her attention—any form of attention, even a simple glance.
It was a Law that made her very presence irresistible.
A Law that allowed Eisheth to turn any sane man or woman into her subordinate, willingly, just so they could keep her happy and be in her presence.
The only reason Varos was still holding onto his sanity was because he was a Transcendent, who had a natural resistance to Eisheth's power.
But even then, with Eisheth and Skyla working together, the Leader of Morblood stood no chance.
It was only a matter of time before he gave in to their demands and...
Surrendered.
Without a fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1967 Leave it to us.
paragraphs: "I do not want any needless bloodshed. Surrender."
"What...?"
Varos narrowed his eyes as he noticed three Transcendent-Level Beings appearing right beside Eisheth. Clearly, the situation was becoming much more dangerous, and despite that...
He still wasn't moving.
He waited for Eisheth to continue.
"You should know who they are."
Eisheth spoke calmly.

Varos stared at the three Transcendents again, and this time, he recognized them. After all, there were only a handful of Transcendent-Level Mercenaries in the entire Universe. Zharak was popular even amongst the other Transcendent-Level Mercenaries.
"I do."
Varos nodded, agreeing to Eisheth's words.
"You should also know that you are incapable of defeating them if they all attack you together."
"I do."
Varos nodded again.
"So surrender."
Eisheth gave a way out.
"There is no need to struggle in vain. Surrender and serve me."
"But... I need to protect Morblood."
Varos answered.
"You can never protect it."
"Why?"
"Its time has come. It will be devoured."
"Who will devour it?"
"My husband."
Eisheth answered.
"Your... husband...?"
Varos tilted his head in confusion.
"Indeed."
Eisheth nodded, her words sounding even more charming as her husband was mentioned.
"My Husband stands against the Very Universe, the Supreme Worlds, the High-Level Worlds. My Husband stands against them all, and in his journey to absoluteness, he wishes to devour Morblood."
"Your Husband... stands against the very Universe...? And the Supreme Worlds...?"
"Indeed."
"Then how come he isn't dead yet?"
"Dead?"
Eisheth smiled at those words.
"My husband cannot die. Be it the Universe, the Supreme Worlds, or anyone else, my Husband will not lose because he is strong."
Eisheth then stared at Varos and,
"He initially decided to kill you himself and take Morblood, but I stopped him.
I do not wish for you to die by my husband's hand. Instead of needlessly trying to protect this world, I want you to serve my husband instead."
The Former Queen then pointed at the Three Transcendents beside her and,
"Just like they do."
"They... serve your husband?"
Varos frowned.
After all, these were mercenaries. The only thing they served was benefits.
"Of course. Why else do you think they stand by my side? They are loyal to my husband."
"So if I am loyal to your husband...
I can stand by your side as well?"
Eisheth just smiled at those words.
"How can I... swear my loyalty to your husband?"
Varos questioned.
He didn't have much of a choice in the matter, now did he?
The woman had three Transcendents by her side. Sure, they were only mercenaries, and in a strict one-on-one battle, he might win against any of them, but if they came together?
He was helpless.
It was a numbers game.
Yes, he might tire them out if he struggled, or even kill one of them, but what good would that do?
His world would still be destroyed, and he would probably be killed as well.
Was it not far better to... survive than be killed?
After all, everything was possible if only he managed to... survive.
So that is what he chose. He chose to survive.
"Morblood's Will. Hand it over."
Eisheth demanded, and Varos, who looked into her eyes, observed her for a few seconds. Then, he raised his hand and...
Flicker
Morblood's Will materialized in his hands.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Morblood, realizing what was going to happen to it, trembled. Its core shook without stopping, but there was nothing it could do.
The one who was supposed to protect it was the one giving it away. There was no way out.
In the end, Varos handed Morblood's Core to Eisheth, and seeing the white ball trembling in his arm, Eisheth's smile widened.
A sight Varos appreciated.
Maybe it wasn't all bad.
Suddenly, the space around Eisheth flickered, and another man appeared beside her—a handsome man with black hair and piercing golden eyes.
"I told you my way's much more efficient, didn't I?"
Eisheth chuckled as she saw the man.
"I helped too!"
Skyla jumped in, happy that she could finally help her husband in some way, even if she only helped him do what he could have done on his own.
"You did well."
Nux chuckled as he gently kissed Skyla's lips. The maid closed her eyes, accepting all the affection.
Nux then turned toward Varos and walked toward him. Varos stared back at him.
He couldn't sense Nux's cultivation. What Eisheth said was true; he didn't stand a chance against him. It was indeed wise to give up.

"I am."

"Let's see if you will react to this or not."

THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER

Crack

In the end, Morblood crumbled into dust, and once again,
The Universe didn't react.

"I am having a hard time getting used to this silence. Feels as if it is preparing a counterattack against me."
"It is preparing a counterattack,"
Suddenly, another voice was heard.
It was Aeliana.
"It just doesn't realize that its counterattack is my father, your father-in-law."
Nux chuckled at those words.
"Anything about Orynthar?"
Aeliana questioned.
"Some basic stuff, the Faction it belongs to, and a bit more. Morblood wasn't connected to Orynthar."
"But it did give you the names of the worlds that were."
Nux shook his head,
"All High-Level Worlds. We need a Middle-Level World."
"I guess we need to continue the search, huh?"
"Well, it just so happened that I gained a few more slots.
I could use a few more Transcendents by my side."
Nux commented as he stared at Eisheth and Skyla, and the two grinned.
"Leave it to us."

sentences.text: "I do not want any needless bloodshed.
Surrender."
"What...?"
Varos narrowed his eyes as he noticed three Transcendent-Level Beings appearing right beside Eisheth.
Clearly, the situation was becoming much more dangerous, and despite that...
He still wasn't moving.
He waited for Eisheth to continue.
"You should know who they are."
Eisheth spoke calmly.
Varos stared at the three Transcendents again, and this time, he recognized them.
After all, there were only a handful of Transcendent-Level Mercenaries in the entire Universe.
Zharak was popular even amongst the other Transcendent-Level Mercenaries.
"I do."
Varos nodded, agreeing to Eisheth's words.
"You should also know that you are incapable of defeating them if they all attack you together."
"I do."
Varos nodded again.
"So surrender."

"There is no need to struggle in vain.

"But...
I need to protect Morblood."
Varos answered.
"You can never protect it."
"Why?"
"Its time has come.

"Who will devour it?"
"My husband."
Eisheth answered.
"Your... husband...?"
Varos tilted his head in confusion.
"Indeed."

"My Husband stands against the Very Universe, the Supreme Worlds, the High-Level Worlds.

"Your Husband... stands against the very Universe...?

"Indeed."
"Then how come he isn't dead yet?"
"Dead?"
Eisheth smiled at those words.
"My husband cannot die.

"They... serve your husband?"
Varos frowned.

The only thing they served was benefits.
"Of course.

They are loyal to my husband."
"So if I am loyal to your husband...
I can stand by your side as well?"
Eisheth just smiled at those words.
"How can I... swear my loyalty to your husband?"
Varos questioned.
He didn't have much of a choice in the matter, now did he?
The woman had three Transcendents by her side.
Sure, they were only mercenaries, and in a strict one-on-one battle, he might win against any of them, but if they came together?
He was helpless.
It was a numbers game.
Yes, he might tire them out if he struggled, or even kill one of them, but what good would that do?
His world would still be destroyed, and he would probably be killed as well.
Was it not far better to... survive than be killed?
After all, everything was possible if only he managed to... survive.
So that is what he chose.
He chose to survive.
"Morblood's Will.
Hand it over."
Eisheth demanded, and Varos, who looked into her eyes, observed her for a few seconds.
Then, he raised his hand and...
Flicker
Morblood's Will materialized in his hands.

THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER

Its core shook without stopping, but there was nothing it could do.
The one who was supposed to protect it was the one giving it away.
There was no way out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1968 Not as useless as you think, now am I?
paragraphs: "Surrender, Draven and Xalvor.
You are up against Five Transcendents. You will not win."
Two Transcendent-Level Beings, Draven and Xalvor, Leaders of a Middle-Level World named Vitalis, stared at the woman sitting on a throne in front of them and stayed silent for a moment.
Right now, they were surrounded by Five Transcendent-Level Beings. It was a battle they couldn't win.
"You should already know, Morblood is destroyed, so is Modics. The next one is your Vitalis, and while it may sound clear, there is nothing you can do to change that."
Skyla spoke up as well.
The two women stared at the two Transcendents standing in the grand hall. Draven and Xalvor stared at each other, and then they nodded and turned back toward Eisheth.
"We surrender."
Just like that, Nux received his Sixth and Seventh Transcendent-Level Subordinates and devoured his Third Middle-Level World.
Inside his Universe, Lyriana, who was staring at the screen that showed Nux's vision, couldn't help but frown as she saw Eisheth effortlessly taking down Transcendents one after the other.
"That Law is too strong."
She commented.
"Something like that shouldn't exist."
"It isn't as strong as you think."
Allura, who was standing next to the Former Elven Queen, smiled lightly, staring at the screen as well.
"What do you mean?"
"They are Transcendents. They have quite a high resistance to her Law. Yes, her Law influences them to some extent, but it is only because, deep down, they know they have no other way out.
It is a choice between death and surrender.
Skyla's Law calms their mind, forcing them to think.
And Eisheth's Law gives them something to look forward to when they choose to surrender.
Combined, both their Laws serve a single purpose: making the choice of surrendering far more appealing than death."
The Succubus explained.
"You seem to understand her Law well, especially Eisheth's."
Melia commented as she stared at Allura. At those words, Allura smiled.
"Their Laws are similar."
Thyra answered.
"Similar? Hers and Eisheth's? Then why haven't you used your Law more often?"
Lyriana questioned with a frown as she glanced at Allura.
"My Law is more focused on Nux."
"What does that mean?"
"My Law is strongest when I use it on Nux.
The Law of Loved One's Temptation, or the Absolute Law of Loved One's Temptation now, allows me to tempt and seduce those who love me. I can make them do whatever I want.
Eisheth's Law, on the other hand, is more practical. It allows her to enchant anyone she wants, no matter whether they love her or not.
Of course, because there is no restriction to her Law, it is weaker compared to mine. My target cannot resist me; hers can."
"But... your only Target is Nux...?"
Lyriana raised her eyebrow.
"That is correct."
Allura nodded.
"Nux cannot resist any one of you anyways.
Your Law is of no use."
Lyriana spoke directly. Allura, however, wasn't offended by those words. Rather, she just chuckled.
"I am just different from the rest of you."
She shrugged.
"You people form your Law so that you can help Nux in the real world. Skyla, Eisheth, and everyone else—you are all the same. I, on the other hand, wish to help Nux's heart and mind instead."
Lyriana tilted her head at those words, confused.
"She keeps him sane."
Felberta answered.
"She keeps him... sane?"
Lyriana blinked, unable to understand.
"That man has billions, if not trillions, of years of memories in his head. A High-Level World, a few Middle-Level Worlds, more than a few Low-Level Worlds, and even more Lowest-Level Worlds.
He has absorbed all these worlds, the knowledge that comes with them, and their memories. And I am not even mentioning the memories of other living beings he has in his head.
Do you think all of this doesn't affect his mind?"
Felberta questioned. Lyriana narrowed her eyes at those words, and seeing her confusion, the Eldraeth Progenitor continued,
"The more you learn, the more you lose your emotions. The more you lose... yourself.
And Nux, whose head is filled with an endless amount of information, would have long lost himself if it weren't for Allura, who keeps bringing him back to us.
She keeps reminding him how much he loves her and all of us whenever Nux is losing himself, and that brings him back right at that moment.
Not just that, her Law also helps Nux calm his raging emotions. It eases his mind, suppresses his negative emotions, and helps him when he is down. To summarize it,
Allura makes sure Nux remains... Nux."
"She makes sure Nux remains Nux..."
Lyriana repeated those words as she stared at Allura, and the Succubus just chuckled playfully.
"See? Not as useless as you think, now am I?"
Lyriana didn't know how to react to those words.
"Hahaha~"
Seeing her hesitate, Allura laughed out loud.
"Don't worry, I am just joking. I know you didn't mean it that way."
"I apologize if I offended you."
Lyriana bowed her head.
"Of course no-"
Allura was about to shake her head, letting it go since it never really mattered to her what others, except for Nux, thought of her. But then, she paused as a thought popped into her head.
After all, her Law wasn't the only thing that kept Nux sane.
There were other reasons—reasons he loved a lot, even more than his life.
And Allura knew the truth.
The more these reasons there are, the less likely it is for Nux to lose himself.
This was also the reason she had been actively seeking more of these reasons as of late.
The two Foxes, then the Seer, and now the Princess—they were all on the list. The Foxes were gone, the Seer is difficult to understand, while the Princess is... well... that is just wishful thinking.
But there was one name on the list whose matter hadn't completely settled yet.
"Do you think a simple apology would cut it?"
Allura questioned back. She was indeed offended.
Lyriana didn't know what to say.
"I want you to do something for me."
Allura spoke up with a big smile on her face.
"If you do that,
I'll forgive you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1969 Now listen to me.
paragraphs: "Anything?"
Amaya questioned again. She had no hopes, but this time, a grin appeared on Nux's face after he was done absorbing the knowledge he just received.
"I knew devouring it would have given us something."
He muttered as he stared at the void in front of him—a void where once Rakthar, a Middle-Level World, stood.
Rakthar was a direct subordinate World of Orynthar. They belonged to the same Faction, and Rakthar's Progenitors directly took orders from Orynthar's men.
"It was about time.
This was already the Eighth one."
Amaya muttered, somewhat relieved.
They had already devoured Seven Middle-Level Worlds and sent countless to reincarnation. If they didn't get anything out of it, it would all be a waste and would put a lot of pressure on Nux.
It was the last thing she wanted.
At the same time, she glanced at the unit of 27 Transcendents hovering in the air right next to them, all of them loyal to Nux.

Yes, Nux now had 27 Transcendents under him—31 if he added the last 4 Transcendents he devoured a few minutes ago. The four of them hadn't been 'recruited' yet. While Eisheth's Law did make them somewhat loyal to Nux, in truth, her Law was too weak. To ensure their loyalty, Nux needed to alter their minds to some extent.
'We got more than something out of this.'
Amaya muttered.
After all, with this many Transcendents under their command, they now had the power to take on any Middle-Level World.
The only real threats to them now were High-Level Worlds and the Supreme Worlds.
"What did you find out?"
Aeliana suddenly questioned.
"The Temple of Time."
"Huh?"
Aeliana frowned.
"You found out about the Temple of Time?"
The women were taken aback. They didn't think that they would get so lucky.
And they weren't.
"I just heard the name again."
Nux answered.
"A representative sent by Orynthar mentioned it once and ordered Rakthar to find out beings with power over time."
"What did he mention?"

"Nothing much. He just told them they needed to clear the Temple of Time. Rakthar wasn't daring enough to ask any more details, nor did they try to find out. They simply did what they were told, found out about Chronoxis, and reported it to Orynthar."
The women widened their eyes, and Nux nodded.
"Yes, Orynthar came after the Foxes because of Rakthar."
"We can finally say that we completed Lady Vulpheon's revenge."
Aeliana muttered with a light smile on her face.
While she herself didn't know much about the Fox Progenitor, the woman had helped her father, and she was grateful for that.
Nux smiled at those words and nodded as well.
"So we still do not know anything accurate."
"We do know that Orynthar knew about the Temple of Time and they wanted to clear it. As for what or where this Temple of Time is, we do not know."
Nux answered.
"It is still progress."
Felberta muttered.
"We now know that Orynthar belonged to the Faction of the Supreme World of Eternity. We know about their close allies and their enemies."

"But all those important players are High-Level Worlds that we cannot attack. I doubt any Middle-Level World will know about the Temple of Time if even Rakthar, Orynthar's direct subordinate, didn't know about it."
Eisheth muttered.
"There are still a few more subordinate worlds that I learned about. They might know something."
Nux spoke up.
"So does this mean we are going to continue?"
Aeliana questioned.
"We have no othe-"
Before Nux could complete his words,
'Nux.'
He heard a voice.
'Mother?'
He frowned.
'Are you going to devour another world?'
'I was planning to.'
'Stop.'
Faustina shook her head.
'Huh?'
Nux frowned.
'Is it... the Universe?'
He questioned.
'It is.'
Faustina nodded.
'The Universe has sent Azriel to where you are. He is tasked to get rid of you.'
'Why isn't Lord Azriel telling me this directly?'
Nux questioned.

'The Universe is keeping strict eyes on his movements, especially right now, when it wants him to move and get rid of the anomaly. It is much more active and has given Azriel the power to instantly destroy anything he points at.
Such power comes with quite a lot of restrictions on what he could and could not do.
He couldn't talk to me either. I had to guess his intentions from his expressions when he was leaving.'
'I'll stop and go away then.'
Nux nodded.
He was wondering when the Universe would lose its patience. It seems that it is finally time.
Nux glanced at his wives and nodded. They had heard the conversation as well, so they nodded back. However, just as everyone was about to return to their own Universe,
'You cannot leave.'
Faustina spoke up.
'What...?'
Nux frowned.
'You have already devoured Eight Middle-Level Worlds. The Universe is angry.'
'It is always angry. I have never seen it happy. It honestly needs to get a lif-'
'Try living with an uncatchable rat that is constantly stealing your things.'
Nux turned silent at those words.
'Anyways.'
Faustina shook her head.
'As I was saying, the Universe is angry.'
'And?'
'It wants Azriel to get rid of the anomaly. If Azriel fails and allows the Anomaly to escape...
He might cease to exist.'
'What...?'
Nux's expression changed. He turned toward Aeliana, who seemed to have frozen after hearing those words.
'Why would it react so strongly?'
Nux frowned in confusion.

'Lord Azriel isn't even an Emperor yet. How is he supposed to catch the Anomaly? Even if he has the Universe's Absolute Power, his senses will be too weak, and he will be in too much danger in front of an enemy.'
'It doesn't matter. The Universe wants the anomaly gone.'
Faustina answered, and Nux's face turned solemn. Soon, however, his expression changed as he noticed something.
His mother...
The woman should be panicking, worrying about Azriel, Aeliana, and her son.
She should be worried sick, and yet...
She sounded calm.
A little too calm.
Almost as if everything was under control.
And just as he thought about it,
'Now listen to me.'
Faustina called out.

They simply did what they were told, found out about Chronoxis, and reported it to Orynthar."
The women widened their eyes, and Nux nodded.
"Yes, Orynthar came after the Foxes because of Rakthar."
"We can finally say that we completed Lady Vulpheon's revenge."
Aeliana muttered with a light smile on her face.
While she herself didn't know much about the Fox Progenitor, the woman had helped her father, and she was grateful for that.
Nux smiled at those words and nodded as well.
"So we still do not know anything accurate."
"We do know that Orynthar knew about the Temple of Time and they wanted to clear it.
As for what or where this Temple of Time is, we do not know."
Nux answered.
"It is still progress."
Felberta muttered.
"We now know that Orynthar belonged to the Faction of the Supreme World of Eternity.
We know about their close allies and their enemies."
"But all those important players are High-Level Worlds that we cannot attack.
I doubt any Middle-Level World will know about the Temple of Time if even Rakthar, Orynthar's direct subordinate, didn't know about it."
Eisheth muttered.
"There are still a few more subordinate worlds that I learned about.
They might know something."
Nux spoke up.
"So does this mean we are going to continue?"
Aeliana questioned.
"We have no othe-"
Before Nux could complete his words,
'Nux.'
He heard a voice.
'Mother?'
He frowned.
'Are you going to devour another world?'
'I was planning to.'
'Stop.'
Faustina shook her head.
'Huh?'
Nux frowned.
'Is it... the Universe?'
He questioned.
'It is.'
Faustina nodded.
'The Universe has sent Azriel to where you are.
He is tasked to get rid of you.'
'Why isn't Lord Azriel telling me this directly?'
Nux questioned.
'The Universe is keeping strict eyes on his movements, especially right now, when it wants him to move and get rid of the anomaly.
It is much more active and has given Azriel the power to instantly destroy anything he points at.
Such power comes with quite a lot of restrictions on what he could and could not do.
He couldn't talk to me either.
I had to guess his intentions from his expressions when he was leaving.'
'I'll stop and go away then.'
Nux nodded.
He was wondering when the Universe would lose its patience.
It seems that it is finally time.
Nux glanced at his wives and nodded.
They had heard the conversation as well, so they nodded back.
However, just as everyone was about to return to their own Universe,
'You cannot leave.'
Faustina spoke up.
'What...?'
Nux frowned.
'You have already devoured Eight Middle-Level Worlds.
The Universe is angry.'
'It is always angry.
I have never seen it happy.
It honestly needs to get a lif-'
'Try living with an uncatchable rat that is constantly stealing your things.'
Nux turned silent at those words.
'Anyways.'
Faustina shook her head.
'As I was saying, the Universe is angry.'
'And?'
'It wants Azriel to get rid of the anomaly.
If Azriel fails and allows the Anomaly to escape...
He might cease to exist.'
'What...?'
Nux's expression changed.
He turned toward Aeliana, who seemed to have frozen after hearing those words.
'Why would it react so strongly?'
Nux frowned in confusion.
'Lord Azriel isn't even an Emperor yet.
How is he supposed to catch the Anomaly?
Even if he has the Universe's Absolute Power, his senses will be too weak, and he will be in too much danger in front of an enemy.'
'It doesn't matter.
The Universe wants the anomaly gone.'
Faustina answered, and Nux's face turned solemn.
Soon, however, his expression changed as he noticed something.
His mother...
The woman should be panicking, worrying about Azriel, Aeliana, and her son.
She should be worried sick, and yet...
She sounded calm.
A little too calm.
Almost as if everything was under control.
And just as he thought about it,
'Now listen to me.'
Faustina called out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1970 The Grand Plan.
paragraphs: "Elyndra and Seraphis."

Eisheth called out as she stared at two beautiful, identical women standing in front of her. The two sisters were tall and slender and had the same elegant, otherworldly beauty. Their skin was soft, pale gray with a faint shimmer, making them look almost ethereal.

Their long, silky silver hair flowed like liquid shadow, reaching past their waists. Their eyes glowed a deep, silver-blue, filled with mystery and intelligence. They had high cheekbones, delicate noses, and full lips that gave them a regal charm.
*Picture*
They were the Echohearts.

A Race that has Power over Sound, they lived in Raghal, a Middle-Level World, and were the strongest of their world. Protecting it from all sorts of threats. They ruled Raghal as the strongest, both sisters taking care of different halves of the World.
Right now, however, the two were surrounded.
"Facing twenty Transcendents at the same time is nothing short of foolishness."
The Succubus Queen, who was sitting on a throne, spoke with a light smile on her face. She then pointed at the Transcendents standing beside her.
"I am sure you recognize more than a few people here. Some are even from Worlds far stronger than your own, yet they still gave in and submitted to their fate."
The woman looked into the Echoheart Sisters' eyes and,
"Do the same.
Surrender, just like they did, and there will be no need to extend this unnecessarily."
The two sisters stared at Eisheth in silence.
In their heads, however, they were conversing without Eisheth knowing about it. They were discussing possible ways to get out of this situation, but...

The moment their eyes fell on the 20 Transcendents in front of them, nothing came to their mind. They had already tried teleporting away, but the Spatial Artifact wasn't working. The Space around them was sealed.
They could try and deploy their domains to fight together, but again, escape didn't seem possible.
Giving up seemed to be the only wise option.
"We surrender."
The two sisters knelt.
Eisheth extended her hand, and the sisters understood what she wanted and nodded.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Echoheart's Will appeared in front of the Succubus, and the World trembled in fear.
Eisheth smiled as she held Echoheart's Core.
Nux appeared in front of the twin sisters and covered them with Black Mist, ready to devour them.
Within a few seconds, the two sisters became part of his Universe. Like before, the Main Universe didn't react.
Nux grinned as he then walked toward Echoheart's Core in Eisheth's hands.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Once again, the world trembled, but Nux didn't care. With the Core in his hands, he surrounded it with the Black Mist.
And then,
'Now!'
He heard a voice, and very quickly, he and the other Transcendents present in the hall disappeared, and another being replaced him in his stead.
It was one of the Sovereigns Amaya and others had once captured for him (chapter 1796).
The Sovereign frowned in confusion. All of his memories were wiped out, so he didn't even know who, where, or what he was.
However, before he could make sense out of the situation,
WHOOOSH
He realized that his surroundings were covered with Dense Black Mist. In an instant, Time, Space, Death, Life, Gravity, Sound—everything around him was sealed, leaving no way out.
"W-W-What...?"
The Sovereign's frown deepened. He couldn't understand what was happening, but his instincts warned him that he was in danger.
He looked around, trying to see a way out, but the only thing he could see was the black mist that was closing its distance and coming toward him from all directions.

The Black Mist felt as if it was made of countless small black holes, devouring everything around it. Even the walls of the Halls, made from the strongest material found in Echoheart, couldn't last for even a single millisecond.
This was the Universe's Wrath.
Its Ultimate Weapon, the Universal Energy, in its densest form.
An energy that could destroy everything and return it to Nothingness—even the Anomaly.
Yes,
The Anomaly was finally gone.
Usually, the Universe couldn't sense the Anomaly. This was the reason the Anomaly had managed to avoid it for such a long time.
This time, however, the Universe had its own eyes.
Its child.
Azriel pointed at the Hall in front of him, and in an instant, the Universe devoured it all.
The Two Transcendent-Level Entities that were present in the Hall were stolen by the Anomaly a few moments ago, so according to its senses, the Hall should have been empty.
Yet, the moment it was devouring the Hall, the Universe realized that it had also devoured another entity together with the Hall.
An Entity that it couldn't sense inside the room.
Yes,
It was the Anomaly.
The Universe was finally able to get rid of this pest, all because of its child.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The entirety of the Universe reacted, this time, not in anger, but in joy.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
All the Worlds present in the Universe, no matter the level, suddenly experienced an explosion of dense energy filling up the air, significantly raising the energy density.
Trillions of Cultivators, from different worlds, managed to break through, reaching levels they normally shouldn't have, at least not this quickly.

In a single moment, the Universe accepted the formation of millions of new Laws, all at the same time. If there was a diary keeping the history of the Universe, this day would have gone down in it as the golden day.
A day when the Universe finally won.
"You sure are happy."
Azriel chuckled as he sensed the Universe's emotions.
'It sure is.'
Nux, who had returned to his Universe, smiled as his mother told him everything that was happening.
Yes, this was the Grand Plan.
The Universe wanted its child to get rid of the Anomaly, so that is what the child did.
He got rid of it and proved its worth.
But...
Who said there can only be one Anomaly?
From now on, the Universe will be attacked by tens of Anomalies.
And every time these anomalies attack, only the Universe's child will have the power to get rid of it.
So from now on, the Universe's Child cannot cease to exist because the Universe would never be able to function without him.
